mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_applications ( id, enterprise_id, job_id, candidate_id, resume_id, idempotency_key, status, created_at, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{jobId}, #{candidateId}, #{resumeId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, false ) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, enterprise_id, job_id, candidate_id, resume_id, status, created_at, updated_at FROM job_applications WHERE id = #{applicationId} AND is_deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE

SELECT ja.job_id, ja.candidate_id, r.id AS resume_id, r.file_name AS resume_file_name, screening.overall_match_score AS ai_screening_score, screening.recommendation AS ai_recommendation, ja.status, ja.created_at, ja.updated_at FROM job_applications ja join resumes r ON ja.resume_id = r.id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT overall_match_score, recommendation FROM application_ai_screenings WHERE application_id = ja.id AND status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) screening ON TRUE WHERE ja.is_deleted = false AND ja.id = #{applicationId} AND ja.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId}

SELECT ja.id, ja.job_id, ja.enterprise_id, j.title AS job_title, prediction.match_score, prediction.pass_probability, ja.status, ja.created_at FROM job_applications ja JOIN jobs j ON ja.job_id = j.id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT match_score, pass_probability FROM candidate_job_match_analyses WHERE application_id = ja.id AND status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) prediction ON TRUE WHERE ja.candidate_id = #{candidateId} AND ja.is_deleted = false
AND ja.status = #{status}
ORDER BY ja.created_at
ASC DESC
